description: This file contains a Swift actor 'TestIsolationLock' that manages a lock mechanism using continuations, and an enum 'TestIsolation' that provides static functions for isolating test environments by temporarily modifying environment variables and user defaults, allowing for isolated test execution.

classes.name: TestIsolationLock
classes.description: A singleton actor managing a lock for synchronizing test setup and teardown.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires the lock, suspending if necessary until it becomes available.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the lock, resuming the next waiting task if any.

methods.name: withIsolatedState
methods.description: Runs a given asynchronous closure within an environment where environment variables and user defaults are temporarily set to specified values, restoring previous state after execution.

methods.name: withEnvValues
methods.description: Convenience method to run a closure with specified environment variable overrides.

methods.name: withUserDefaultsValues
methods.description: Convenience method to run a closure with specified user defaults overrides.

methods.name: tempConfigPath
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary file path for configuration, nonisolated from actor environment.
